name: Demo Operational Maturity

smartGoal.statement: By 2027-12-31, evolve and mature the existing Demo Services operating model to improve clarity, efficiency, visibility, and consistency in support, decisioning, and engagement across all products, platforms, and regions.

objectives: Design clear visual flow diagrams for support decisioning
Refresh team ownership maps and contact lists
Reinforce mandatory ticketing for all demo engagements
Surface operational flows and ownership in the platform

metrics: Repeat issues due to misrouting: Baseline → -50%

achievable.resources: Process design expertise, platform engineering, knowledge management tools
achievable.ownership: Demo Ops owns process design, IT supports platform integration, Leadership enforces adoption

timeline.deliverable: Visual flow diagrams and standard paths for support decisioning
Updated ownership maps and contact lists aligned to org structure
Mandatory ticketing embedded in operational workflows
Operational flows and support models visible in Executive Summary Platform

lagging.name: Time to route to correct team

operationalEffectiveness: Mean time to correct team assignment (decrease)
processAdoption: % of demo engagements with tickets logged
% of support requests following defined decision flows
Audit compliance on ticket + documentation usage
visibilityAndAccuracy: Knowledge base freshness score (last updated within SLA)
Platform visibility completeness (flows, ownership, escalation paths)
leadershipConfidence: Reduction in leadership escalations for 'who owns this?'
Stakeholder satisfaction with support clarity (quarterly pulse)

strategicValue: This goal ensures Demo Services operates as a scaled, enterprise-grade function, enabling faster execution, lower operational friction, reduced dependency on tribal knowledge, improved predictability and reliability, stronger support for automation and digital-first demos, and leadership confidence in operational control.
whyThisMatters: Demo Services already operates with established processes, documentation, and operational frameworks. However, as demo becomes more strategic, automated, and revenue-critical, the operating model must mature to support scale, speed, and complexity. This goal focuses on refinement, standardisation, and visibility, not reinvention.
